about: Mock inbox for the Monday 4:00 PM demo (docs/workflow-and-timing.md section 6). Each referral is one of the organizers' synthetic patients in demo/synthetic/: every person, hospital, phone number and email is invented. Nothing is ever sent.

referrals.subject: Recuperative care referral S06: Acute ischemic stroke, left middle cerebral artery territory, with right-sided weakness
referrals.body: Recuperative care referral. 71-year-old woman, stroke 09/02, medically stable. Walks with a walker. Unhoused with no family. Rehab facilities have not accepted. Please consider.

referrals.subject: Recuperative care referral S01: Cellulitis of left lower leg
referrals.body: Referral for recuperative care. 54-year-old man with left leg cellulitis, now on oral antibiotics and medically ready for discharge 08/07. Unhoused, no place to elevate the leg or keep it clean. Independent with all care. Please review and advise.

referrals.subject: Recuperative care referral S09: Abscess of right forearm with cellulitis, status post incision and drainage
referrals.body: Recuperative care referral for today if possible. 33-year-old woman, forearm abscess drained 09/13, on oral antibiotics. Unhoused. Independent. Remaining documents available on request.

referrals.subject: Recuperative care referral S05: Cellulitis of right hand
referrals.body: Recuperative care referral. 39-year-old man with right hand cellulitis, improving on oral antibiotics. Unhoused. Independent. History of schizoaffective disorder. Medically cleared.

referrals.subject: Recuperative care referral S04: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe, with COPD exacerbation
referrals.body: Recuperative care referral. 66-year-old man with pneumonia and COPD. Off oxygen since 08/26, on oral antibiotics, walking on his own. No home oxygen needed. Unhoused. Ready 08/28.
